issue.title: Project stats Code snapshot misses cold (7.6 s vs 5 s) and changed-tip (0.92 s vs 0.5 s) budgets

task_type_fields.impact: Cold Code measurement for a large repo (sase) takes ~7.6 s on first open of the Statistics → Projects tab or the first sase stats project run, and each new commit costs ~0.9 s to re-measure on the next refresh; both exceed the approved plan budgets.
task_type_fields.location: sase-core crates/sase_core/src/project_stats/snapshot (tree listing, committed check-attr, per-blob counting)
task_type_fields.repro:
Proposed by phase sase-1m3.7.1.5 (note #6) and routed to the outer epic by the
sase-1m3.7.1 land agent (sase-1m3 note #3, sase-1m3.7 notes #2 and #4); recorded again by
sase-1m3.12 as a budget miss. Filed by the sase-1m3 land agent because the approved plan
(plan:202610/sase_stats_project.md §20) sends budget misses with evidence to follow-ups.

Measured on the release binding over sase tree c4299924ba07 (14,477 tracked / 12,432
code files, core b8737fa5, tokei SLOC), against plan §6.3 budgets:

- cold LoC 7.628 s (fixture range 6.397–8.571 s) vs 2–5 s;
- warm LoC after one new commit (changed tip) 0.922 s vs < 0.5 s;
- same tip 37.187 ms (meets < 150 ms).

Audit: 13,249 unique cold blob reads, zero same-tip reads, exactly one changed-tip blob
read, and the changed-tip result equals cold. Instrumented changed-tip Git time 0.575 s =
`ls-tree` 0.177 s + committed `check-attr` 0.336 s + `cat-file` 0.005 s. A nonblank
(pre-tokei) baseline also missed changed-tip (0.616 s), so tokei is not the cause.
Evidence: report file:explicit:f8fc12f54cb3f9b647451035, bundle
file:explicit:cf0a3ec863e10c52c0785b78.

Leads: (1) on a cached-tree transition use `git diff-tree -r -z <cached_tree> <new_tree>`
and re-run `check-attr` only for changed paths when no `.gitattributes` blob changed,
instead of a full `ls-tree` + full `check-attr`; (2) parallelize cold per-blob
classification and counting. The fixed per-spawn overhead tracked separately in the
warm-latency task also inflates these numbers.

Repro: the ignored project_stats Code acceptance benchmark in sase-core
(`crates/sase_core/src/project_stats/`, release build) against a sase checkout, or time a
`{code}` `query_project_stats` call with an empty cache dir, then again after one new
commit.

issue.creation_reason: The core-code phase and the acceptance phase of epic sase-1m3 measured Code snapshot budget misses with evidence and leads; the approved plan routes such misses to a follow-up, so the sase-1m3 land agent files it here.

payload.description: Shared fixed per-spawn git overhead inflates the Code cold/changed-tip numbers; fix or re-measure together
